data.body:
E2E evidence through the REAL binary and the REAL store (not a patched unit test):

  $ rebar review 003d-e6b0-9e58-4b52     # a closed ticket
  stderr: rebar review is deprecated; use rebar review-plan (scheduled for removal in v1.0.0).
  stdout: "verdict": "INDETERMINATE", "llm_ran": false, "signed": false
  exit 2

That single run proves three ACs on the product surface at once: the fast-fail divergence (AC7 - exit 2, no LLM), the read-only contract (AC2 - signed:false, so the bare verb still writes no attestation), and the CLI deprecation signal (AC4).

Also confirmed through the real binary:
  rebar review <id> --graph          -> exit 2, message names review-plan
  rebar review <id> ticket-quality   -> exit 2, message names review-plan
  rebar review --help                -> contains attestation / BLOCKING / FAST-FAIL / MULTI-PASS (AC6)

AC13 grep is now clean: 'grep -n "rebar review " docs/llm-framework.md docs/cli-reference.md AGENTS.md' returns ZERO lines, and docs/output-schemas.md's review row reads plan_review_verdict.

AC10 verified explicitly: tests/unit/test_clarity_floor.py + test_config_ticket_clarity.py + test_det_floor_clarity.py = 63 passed, and the -k 'clarity_check or check_ac or quality_check' selection = 11 passed / 3 skipped.

Gerrit change 1407: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1407 - awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1. Ticket stays in_progress until the change is Verified +1 and merged.
